WITH quarterly_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        -- Group customers into quarterly cohorts based on their tenure
        CASE 
            WHEN tenureyrs % 4 = 0 THEN 4 
            ELSE tenureyrs % 4 
        END AS cohort_quarter,
        -- Identify digital natives based on high online and mobile banking usage
        CASE 
            WHEN chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' AND chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High' THEN TRUE 
            ELSE FALSE 
        END AS is_digital_native,
        coreregistry
    FROM 
        core_record
),
engagement_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        bankexpref, 
        -- Calculate engagement score
        bankrelscore AS engagement_score 
    FROM 
        bank_and_transactions
),
analytic_data AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.cohort_quarter,
        qc.is_digital_native,
        COUNT(DISTINCT qc.coreregistry) AS cohort_size,
        AVG(es.engagement_score) AS avg_engagement_score,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN es.engagement_score > 0.7 THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) * 100.0 / COUNT(qc.coreregistry) AS high_engagement_percentage,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN qc.is_digital_native AND es.engagement_score > 0.7 THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) * 100.0 / COUNT(qc.coreregistry) AS high_engagement_digital_native_percentage
    FROM 
        quarterly_cohorts qc
    JOIN 
        expenses_and_assets ea ON qc.coreregistry = ea.expemplref
    JOIN 
        engagement_scores es ON ea.expemplref = es.bankexpref
    GROUP BY 
        qc.cohort_quarter, qc.is_digital_native
)
SELECT 
    cohort_quarter, 
    is_digital_native, 
    cohort_size, 
    avg_engagement_score, 
    high_engagement_percentage, 
    high_engagement_digital_native_percentage
FROM 
    analytic_data;

WITH quarterly_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        -- Group customers into quarterly cohorts based on their tenure
        CASE 
            WHEN tenureyrs % 4 = 0 THEN 4 
            ELSE tenureyrs % 4 
        END AS cohort_quarter,
        coreregistry
    FROM 
        core_record
),
digital_natives AS (
    SELECT 
        coreregistry, 
        -- Identify digital natives based on high online and mobile banking usage
        CASE 
            WHEN onlineuse = 'High' AND mobileuse = 'High' THEN TRUE 
            ELSE FALSE 
        END AS is_digital_native
    FROM 
        bank_and_transactions
),
engagement_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        bankexpref, 
        -- Calculate engagement score
        bankrelscore AS engagement_score 
    FROM 
        bank_and_transactions
),
analytic_data AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.cohort_quarter,
        dn.is_digital_native,
        COUNT(DISTINCT qc.coreregistry) AS cohort_size,
        AVG(es.engagement_score) AS avg_engagement_score,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN es.engagement_score > 0.7 THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) * 100.0 / COUNT(qc.coreregistry) AS high_engagement_percentage,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN dn.is_digital_native AND es.engagement_score > 0.7 THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) * 100.0 / COUNT(qc.coreregistry) AS high_engagement_digital_native_percentage
    FROM 
        quarterly_cohorts qc
    JOIN 
        expenses_and_assets ea ON qc.coreregistry = ea.expemplref
    JOIN 
        digital_natives dn ON ea.expemplref = dn.coreregistry
    JOIN 
        engagement_scores es ON ea.expemplref = es.bankexpref
    GROUP BY 
        qc.cohort_quarter, dn.is_digital_native
)
SELECT 
    cohort_quarter, 
    is_digital_native, 
    cohort_size, 
    avg_engagement_score, 
    high_engagement_percentage, 
    high_engagement_digital_native_percentage
FROM 
    analytic_data;
